{{Quote|There was a lot of that on Little Atullus then &ndash; talk that a better life awaited you on the unspoiled worlds beyond the Rim.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Little Atullus''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] astronomical object located in the [[Anthos sector/Legends|Anthos sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|soldier]]. During the [[Republic soldier|soldier's]] [[Youngling/Legends|childhood]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Tionese War]], [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] sold the [[Gender/Legends|boy's]] [[Unidentified parents|parents]] some [[Unidentified farm (Okator VIII)|farmland]] on the celestial body [[Okator VIII]]. After moving to their new home on Okator VIII, the boy eventually forgot about Little Atullus despite still seeing it in his [[Dream/Legends|dreams]].

==Description==
Little Atullus was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Little Atullus system/Legends|Little Atullus system]], a part of the [[Anthos sector/Legends|Anthos sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|I grew up on Little Atullus, but my parents brought me to Okator VIII when I was a boy.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
Little Atullus was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Tionese War]], when the [[Republic soldier|soldier]] was still a young [[Youngling/Legends|boy]], their [[Unidentified parents|parents]] invested their life savings into a land property on [[the Divide]] astronomical object [[Okator VIII]] that was offered by a group of [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] from<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The [[Gender/Legends|boy]] and their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] left Little Atullus for Okator VIII. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], life at the [[Unidentified farm (Okator VIII)|farm]] made the boy forget about their original homeworld, even though they kept [[Dream/Legends|dreaming]] about it. The boy eventually survived a [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[attack on Okator VIII]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> around [[23,900 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}} places the [[attack on Okator VIII]] shortly before the end of the [[Tionese War]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to approximately [[23,900 BBY]].</ref> that destroyed their family's [[Farm/Legends|farm]], and afterward they became a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] for the Republic. In an account of the attack imprinted on a [[Baragwin sense lattice]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the soldier characterized the traders on Little Atullus who had sold their parents land as "hotshots" and further noted that many on Little Atullus at the time had claimed that a better life awaited potential [[Colonist/Legends|settlers]] on "unspoiled" worlds beyond the region known by then as the Rim&mdash;a sentiment with which the soldier partially agreed with regard to their pastoral life on Okator VIII.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Little Atullus was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the astronomical object was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Little Atullus was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Little Atullus [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square N-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
